688:t_10:26.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「Is it all right for you to be moving around already?」

688:t_10:27.en:
$$エスター$$
「Yeah... Now that I can move my body again, the food is just so delicious, so delicious.」

688:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, $$エスター$$. Shall we perform the $c induction ritual once more?」

688:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Let's give it our all again today...!」

688:t_10:31.en:
$$エスター$$
「Wait! I said that in the heat of the moment, but this is mind control!」

688:t_10:32.en:
$$トライア$$
「Don't worry, $$エスター$$. Just in case, I gave $n the detonator switch for the bomb I planted on this guy.」

688:t_10:34.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「As expected, Doctor. So you never trusted this guy after all.」

688:t_10:36.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「He's the only one not under the $$バインドスペル$$'s control, so if anything happens, he'll press the switch without hesitation.」

688:t_10:39.en:
$$エスター$$
「There he goes, Mr. Con!」

688:t_10:40.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ugh... From now on I shall exercise restraint, I shall...」

688:t_10:41.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But I shall continue to celebrate those who become ace pilots!」

688:t_10:42.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course, nobody will be in the mood today, but I sincerely await the visits of all you ace pilots!」

689:t_000:1.en:
$$リーロン$$
「The position sensor's coordinates are still pointing at the galactic center, but...」

689:t_000:2.en:
$$凱$$
「It's the same as back then! Same as when we were transferred out of the galactic center before!」

689:t_000:4.en:
$$號$$
「No... We came here of our own will.」

689:t_000:6.en:
$$トライア$$
「The world beyond the $$天柱$$ at the galactic center...」

689:t_000:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The universe where the $$御使い$$s dwell... Its name is the $$カオス・コスモス$$...」

689:t_000:8.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「Hold on, $$ＡＧ$$. How do you know the name of this place?」

689:t_000:9.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Talk later. They're coming.」

689:t_001:1.en:
$$渓$$
「I knew it, this is the universe where those guys live!」

689:t_001:3.en:
$$リーロン$$
「Sortie prep is OK! $$ノノ$$ and $$ラルク$$ are here too!」

689:t_001:4.en:
$$トライア$$
「$$クロウ$$, $$ランド$$, $$セツコ$$, $n! All of you, sortie! Hurry!」

689:t_002:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「Sending a welcome party right away? What dutiful guys!」

689:t_002:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Even sending out new faces... That's a warm welcome indeed.」

689:t_002:2.en:
$$真徒$$
「Shut your mouths, inferior species. You are defiling this $$カオス・コスモス$$.」

689:t_002:5.en:
$$真徒$$
「Do you think the Exalted Ones would deign to face the likes of you?」

689:t_002:6.en:
$$真徒$$
「You seem to have gotten the wrong idea just from taking down a mere $$バアル$$. Your arrogance is beyond the pale.」

689:t_002:8.en:
$$真徒$$
「We are the $$真徒$$s... The people chosen from among all universes.」

689:t_002:9.en:
$$真徒$$
「Beings who have been promised eternity by the Exalted Ones.」

689:t_002:12.en:
$$真徒$$
「Do not speak that name lightly!」

689:t_002:13.en:
$$真徒$$
「We have no wish to speak with you. The mission given to us is the extermination of inferior species.」

689:t_002:15.en:
$$真徒$$
「Chant the words of salvation! Salus!!」

689:t_002:18.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「So they're lapdogs who blindly obey overwhelming power.」

689:t_002:19.en:
$$真徒$$
「If you still don't understand your place, then we will teach you!」

689:t_002:20.en:
$$真徒$$
「Receive the mercy of the Exalted Ones, who have permitted us to use this $$ゼル・ビレニウム$$!」

689:t_002:21.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$ゼル・ビレニウム$$... So that's the name of that crystal giant.」

689:t_002:22.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Tch...! Looks like it outranks the crystal monsters!」

689:t_002:23.en:
$$真徒$$
「I'll have you know, this is not the only force we have.」

689:t_003:0.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「The $$アンチスパイラル$$ army!」

689:t_003:1.en:
$$真徒$$
「That has already perished. We shall be making use of its forces.」

689:t_003:2.en:
$$真徒$$
「If only you had been as smart as that one.」

689:t_003:6.en:
$$シモン$$
「You feel it too, don't you, $$ブータ$$... The meaning of this universe.」

689:t_003:9.en:
$$トライア$$
「There's no escape. We have no choice but to do it.」

689:t_003:10.en:
$$トライア$$
「$$クロウ$$, $$セツコ$$, $$ランド$$, $n! You're heading to the points I'm about to designate!」

689:t_004:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
「The middle of the enemy lines...!」

689:t_004:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「Explanations later! If you don't want to die, hurry!」

689:t_004:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「There's bound to be a key to turning this around there...!」

689:t_004:6.en:
$$トライア$$
「$$セツコ$$, the point at 2 o'clock is yours!」

689:t_005:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「$$ランド$$, the point at 4 o'clock is yours!」

689:t_006:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「$$クロウ$$, the point at 8 o'clock is yours!」
